projects.name: 3 tire 22. shell Dream Cature
projects.shortDescription: A three-ring dream catcher made with .22 shells, paperclip cores, and continuous webbing; one of my most popular designs while I sold them.

projects.name: 3D 22. shell dream cature
projects.shortDescription: A one-off three-dimensional .22 shell dream catcher with a center stone, originally hung from my father’s rear-view mirror.

projects.name: Dragon Attack Shield
projects.shortDescription: A handmade dragon-themed attack shield developed from an original doodle into a paper model and eventually a finished painted shield.

projects.name: Dragon Gauntlets
projects.shortDescription: A mismatched pair of metal dragon gauntlets combining different pattern sources, modified with claw-like fingers and thick leather wrists.

projects.name: Dragon Helmet
projects.shortDescription: A modular metal dragon helmet based on a Prince Armory pattern, modified with a more open Roman/Greek-style lower guard and interchangeable face guards.

projects.name: Dragon Poulerns
projects.shortDescription: Metal dragon pauldrons based on a Prince Armory pattern and modified to incorporate throwing spikes at the shoulders.

projects.name: Spiral 22. shell Dream Cature
projects.shortDescription: My largest dream catcher, transformed from a frustrating diamond-spiral design into a hanging copper-and-.22-shell spiral with amethyst and a naturally curled feather.
